digest.component_or_area: Jira reconciler rich-text codec and sync layer
propositions: Cloud descriptions and comments must encode Markdown as structured ADF (not plain-text paragraphs) through production codec paths and maintain idempotent round-trip conversion
Data Center safe Markdown must render as native Jira wiki markup (not literal source) through production codec paths without monotonic content decay over repeated passes
Bidirectional sync must suppress echo loops via ADR-0026 per-binding baseline tracking, change-gated rich_sha, and three-way LWW conflict detection with concurrent-edit flagging
Jira-native constructs (panels, mentions, dates) must survive rebar-originated reconcile passes through origin-gated outbound normalization that preserves existing rich-text marks
Comment creation must route through the same rich-text codec as descriptions with an append-only Jira-comment-ID map, creating comments only once in either direction
DC rendering must handle subprocess timeout, pandoc absence, and pathological input with safe fallback, plus persist GPL/SBOM obligations for the bundled pandoc binary
